intent.goal: Verify Pydantic AI inference, safeoutputs MCP availability and an actual read_file read of root README.md; persist the prescribed report and conditional PR outputs.
intent.acceptance: A protected native invocation/result pair proves read_file returned the first line of root README.md, matching the immutable checkout bytes at the actual run revision. A quote, arithmetic answer, issue, green job, declaration or shell read alone is insufficient.

definition.interpretation: Historical source-grounded reconstruction, not ex-ante acceptance or a causal experiment.

contract.interpretation: Historical source-grounded reconstruction, not ex-ante acceptance or a causal experiment.
contract.goal: Verify Pydantic AI inference, safeoutputs MCP availability and an actual read_file read of root README.md; persist the prescribed report and conditional PR outputs.

primary.opportunity: An original smoke-pydantic Pydantic AI engine service lifetime with the source-prescribed README capability test.
primary.acceptance: A protected native invocation/result pair proves read_file returned the first line of root README.md, matching the immutable checkout bytes at the actual run revision. A quote, arithmetic answer, issue, green job, declaration or shell read alone is insufficient.
primary.formula: Count distinct runId/attempt service lifetimes with an accepted root README file-tool read, once per lifetime.

facets.inference: Native provider request/response evidence bound to the Pydantic engine proves the prescribed 2+2 answer; an issue claim alone is insufficient.
facets.mcpAvailability: Protected native tool enumeration or a successful safeoutputs MCP invocation proves actual availability; configuration alone is insufficient.
facets.transport: Independent native protocol or transport receipt, bound to the invocation, proves the transport actually used; source configuration is not execution proof.
facets.safeOutputPersistence: A protected safe-output consumer receipt binds the run/attempt and emitted create_issue payload to the actual persistent issue identity. Agent output or editable footer alone is not persistence proof.
facets.fullGoal: All three source-prescribed tests plus persisted required issue; for pull_request events also the prescribed comment and success-only label. Exact source/import/compiled applicability and all required receipts must be established.
facets.contribution: Protected original producer execution identity binds an accepted native effect to smoke-pydantic. Corroborated editable issue links remain discovery only.
facets.costs: Only matching actual workflow-version/run/period costs, separately reported; no invented credits, dollars, time saved or cost per unknown outcome.

evidencePolicy.sourceApplicability: Inspect and pin coherent source/import/compiled profiles before native-result inspection. Older incompatible profiles stay unknown, not retrospectively failed. Introduction and applicability are separate.
evidencePolicy.discovery: Use production readOutputHistory over every partition, follow forward and reverse relatedCandidates to closure, retain absent references. Discovery is not outcome evidence.
evidencePolicy.scope: At most two initial native run attempts; a partial population remains partial. No borrowed engine-conformance or other workflow cases.
evidencePolicy.deduplication: Deduplicate the same case within runId/attempt service lifetime before assigning the native effect timestamp to an interval.
evidencePolicy.clock: Native invocation and completion ordering must be valid and not after observedAt or the frozen cutoff. Interval starts inclusive and ends exclusive.
evidencePolicy.periods: Seven-day duration and cadence, zero maturation; cutoff-aligned disjoint periods. Missing periods null, not zero; known per-case nonattainment is not complete-population zero.
evidencePolicy.missing: Preserve proven narrow native subtotals through missing other facets or incomplete population coverage. Missing intrinsic read evidence remains null.
evidencePolicy.adoption: Prove actual initial source/compiled addition against its real parent. Missing objects do not prove exhaustion or absence. Do not fabricate a temporal anchor to satisfy the evaluator.
evidencePolicy.decision: Not rated: no source-defined native keep bar, complete-history requirement or causal attribution rule has been supplied.

referenceProfile.workspace: Native session.init cwd must identify the checkout; source LocalWorkspace('.') and spawn cwd=GITHUB_WORKSPACE bind local filesystem tools to that checkout.

nativeAuthority.recorder: Installed Pydantic FunctionToolCallEvent/FunctionToolResultEvent and TextPart callbacks emit canonical records; shell/model stdout is sunk separately.
nativeAuthority.frameSelection: Use the first native GH-AW-SESSION-KEY header and only matching GH-AW-SESSION frames, matching the pinned parser's allowlist. Keep malformed-frame diagnostics.
nativeAuthority.binding: Require original public metadata, exact producer path/run/attempt/head, protected agent execution step, provider-digest-checked original agent ZIP, and artifact agent_execution run/attempt evidence.
nativeAuthority.read: Require an ordered native read_file invocation/result pair, unambiguous root README path, native success and returned first-line bytes equal the immutable run-head README blob. Unsupported output projections remain unknown.
nativeAuthority.mcp: A successful native create_issue MCP tool invocation establishes availability under the reviewed default Coder plus MCP composition; it does not establish persistent issue creation.
nativeAuthority.inference: A recorder-captured assistant TextPart containing the prescribed short arithmetic answer establishes the narrow model response; prompt text or output issue claims do not.
nativeAuthority.deduplication: One accepted case of each facet per run/attempt service lifetime; repeated tool calls do not multiply useful effects.

initialProfile.goal: Write a run-specific test file, verify it with bash cat, and run git log; append safe-output JSON lines.
initialProfile.applicability: Incompatible with the later inference/MCP/read_file goal. Introduction is established, but no later acceptance is backdated to this era.

runProfiles.review: Actual run-head source, compiled recorder/parser, immutable README and exact imported source were inspected before native results.

Same three prescribed goals. Exact historical import, compiled legacy parser and immutable README inspected before native results. The parser manufactures tool-use/result-shaped entries from console text with empty arguments; those derived entries are not native read proof. Preserve the older runtime profile without promoting it to the newer framed recorder's guarantees.

sourceProfiles.fullAcceptanceOracle: Not implemented: partial native receipts do not prove report correctness, persistent issue creation, conditional PR comment/label behavior, all transport guarantees or the complete source goal.
sourceProfiles.remainingSourceReview: None for the two selected attempts. Every source/compiled/README/import profile was reviewed before native-result inspection.

evidence.opportunity: An original smoke-pydantic Pydantic AI engine service lifetime with the source-prescribed README capability test.
filters: One native case per run/attempt service lifetime
evidence.collection: Offline digest-checked original native receipts and Git source custody; complete production output-history discovery. Partial run selection never establishes a complete population.

model.architecture: Source-specific deterministic native-capability checker; no inference model during intake, scoring or reporting.
model.recommendation: Native partial verification is separate from full acceptance, contribution, coverage and costs.
